script.base: One-score game, TB holding a late lead at home under a 43 total. Pace stays moderate and both offenses stay run-leaning: Irving keeps the early-down load, Bijan stays ATL's hub, and Penix's throws concentrate short and middle because TB blitzes 41% and his EPA is better vs blitz (-0.01, n=91) than vs no blitz (-0.14). Scoring lives in the 20s, not a shootout.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Pitts is ATL's short/middle answer (6 targets and 41 rec yds per game L3, 3.8 aDOT) into the only area TB bleeds (9.53 YPA middle), and TB's 41% blitz is the look Penix has actually handled, which pushes throws to the TE.
edge_players.must_be_true: Pitts plays a normal route share with no snap limit (inactives still pending), ATL throws enough in a one-score game, and TB does not suddenly take away the middle.
edge_players.kills_it: A closed-middle shell, a Pitts inactive or rep limit, or a pure Bijan clock-grind that leaves Penix without the targets to clear 34.5.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Irving is the home favorite's bellcow at 21 carries and 106 rush yards per game over the last three, and ATL allows 4.04 YPC, so 70.5 still clears if he only regresses to the mid-teens in carries while TB is tied or leading.

data_check.notes: No projection model, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig in the pack, so step 8 cannot stamp a true edge percent; do not treat either leg as 70%+. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Pitts went quiet because TB played the middle closed, London (32 L3 targets) soaked the volume, and one of three games carried the 124 yards; the 49 middle attempts are a small sample that did not show up, and a Bijan-heavy script (46 carries L3) kept Penix from feeding 34.5. Irving finished in the 50s: the 106-yard L3 was three soft fronts, Gainwell vultured the change-of-pace work he already had (20 carries, 6.15 YPC), ATL's 4.04 YPC allowed was opponent-driven, and a first-half ATL lead on only a 2-point spread flipped TB off the run. The pending inactive list, not the box score, is the miss if either was limited.
slip_story: One-score TB home lean, not a shootout and not a blowout clock-kill. Irving rush over needs TB tied or leading so the carry share lives; Pitts rec over needs ATL throwing into the middle, which still happens in a one-score game and also survives the TB-leads flip. Do not add a total under, a London over, or a Dotson over; those need a different script or a chunk profile TB's 16 explosives do not support. No TD legs. Slip stops at these two until inactives and a no-vig price exist.
